analyses.question: How have Ghana mobile internet subscription counts and market shares changed over 31 months?
analyses.approach: Monthly shares, relative count growth, share percentage-point changes, net-growth contribution, alternative date windows, and anomalies
analyses.finding: MTN added 5,673,061 subscriptions Jan 2024–Jul 2026 while share fell 81.61% to 80.02%; Telecel share gained 2.92pp; AT lost 1.33pp.
analyses.status: Historical analysis retained; headline excluded from active GILB-002 editorial scope (NCA conflicting releases)
analyses.peer_check: 93/93 values and 31/31 mobile totals matched NCA primary PDF tables (AI-assisted verification; external human sign-off pending)
analyses.repro_notes: Read v2 report; replay tools/verify_gilb002_nca_v2.py; inspect 93-row source comparison ledger; preserve original NCA PDFs
analyses.limitations: Historical time-series comparison is not selected for public story because of cross-publication conflicts; original analysis files retained for audit.

analyses.question: GILB002-SAFE-SCOPE-Q1-2026 — Compare Q1 2026 subscription shares with traffic shares
analyses.approach: Read NCA Q1 2026 Tables 15/18, reconcile traffic TB and compute traffic share minus end-quarter subscription share; exclude conflicting cross-report values.
analyses.finding: MTN: 80.12% share of March-end MNO mobile data subscriptions vs 87.31% of Jan–Mar 2026 data traffic, +7.19 percentage points.
analyses.status: Clean source-scope comparison prepared; editorial approval and final factual sign-off pending
analyses.peer_check: Q1 shares and MTN/Telecel March counts agree with July monthly release; traffic arithmetic checks pass in Q1 bulletin.
analyses.repro_notes: Read the Word methodology report, CSV and run the v3 Python reproduction script.
analyses.limitations: Q1 traffic is aggregate volume while subscription share is March-end stock. AT exact March counts differ by 4 across sources; no causal or customer-level inference.
